summary: Former lookout cab on Bald (Dooley) Mountain, Baker County: built 1934 or 1936 per two register entries, abandoned by 1947 on one of them; gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two register entries give different years and elevations. Bald (Dooley) (US 1104) gives 1934 and 6,683 ft; Dooley Mountain (US 1116) gives 1936 and 6,151 ft, about 5 km to the northeast. They may be one site recorded twice or two nearby sites. firelookout.com's Dooley page says the site may not have been used and refers readers to the Bald Mtn. account.

notes_for_editor: The record's Bald (Dooley) entry (US 1104) and the register's second Dooley Mountain entry (US 1116) disagree on the build year (1934 against 1936), the abandonment (1947 on US 1116 only), and the elevation (6,683 ft against 6,151 ft). Their coordinates are about 5 km apart: US 1104 at 44.57412, -117.89368 and US 1116 at 44.58244, -117.83097. firelookout.com's Dooley page gives 6151 ft and points to the Bald Mtn. account, so the editor should decide whether these are one site recorded twice before the record's elevation and location are trusted. The record's 2037 m is the US 1104 figure and is not necessarily wrong for that entry. Rex's page treats Bald Mountain as the same station through 1975, while the 1947 abandonment date is not reconciled with it. John Badon (Rex, 1933) and John Bacon (firelookout.com, 1932) may be the same man. No source describes what remains on the site, and no source gives access. The Rex 'Removed' heading carries no date. The brief lists the agency as 'U.S.Forest Service' with no space; the story uses 'U.S. Forest Service'.
